title: Antom 3-in-1 Transformer: A Payment Foundation Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.25403v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We report the development of Antom 3-in-1 Transformer, a payment foundation model that integrates sequence, tabular, and graph representations for payment risk detection. The model contains approximately 7B parameters, with approximately 1.7B activated per task route. Antom 3-in-1 Transformer is pretrained to learn reusable behavioral and relational representations, primarily on Ant International's internal payment data. In a cross-business transfer experiment, pretraining improves the target business metric by 34.5% over the same architecture trained from scratch. With only 25% of the training labels, the pretrained model outperforms the full-label scratch baseline in Average Precision (AP) and Recall@0.5% on different merchant domains. In a four-month online experiment on Ant International's billion-scale payment platform, the model reduced the overall loss rate by 37.88% relative to XGB-Online.

translated_title: Antom 三合一 Transformer：支付基础模型
translated_abstract: 我们报告了 Antom 三合一 Transformer 的开发工作，这是一个面向支付风险检测的支付基础模型，它集成了序列、表格和图三种表示形式。该模型包含约 70 亿参数，每个任务路由仅激活约 17 亿参数。该模型主要在蚂蚁国际的内部支付数据上进行预训练，以学习可复用的行为和关系表示。在一项跨业务迁移实验中，预训练使目标业务指标相比相同架构从零训练提升了 34.5%。在仅有 25% 训练标签的情况下，预训练模型在不同商户领域的平均精度和 Recall@0.5% 上均优于使用全量标签从零训练的基线模型。在蚂蚁国际十亿级支付平台进行的为期四个月的在线实验中，该模型相比 XGB-Online 将整体损失率降低了 37.88%。
tldr: 本文提出了面向支付风险检测的支付基础模型 Antom 三合一 Transformer，通过融合序列、表格和图表示进行预训练，实现了跨业务迁移能力的大幅提升，并在线上实验中显著降低了支付损失率。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Antom 3-in-1 Transformer, a payment foundation model that integrates sequence, tabular, and graph representations for payment risk detection, achieving substantial cross-business transfer improvements and significantly reducing loss rates in online experiments.
